description: This file implements inter-chip communication and telemetry event handling, including inotify event listening, profile management, and result processing for inter-processor communication in a telemetry system.

methods.name: initGrepMarkerMap
methods.description: Initializes the grep marker map if not already initialized.

methods.name: freegrepMarkerListMap
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a grep marker list entry.

methods.name: addGrepMarkersToMap
methods.description: Reads grep marker configuration from a file and populates the marker list and map.

methods.name: removeProfileMarkers
methods.description: Removes all markers associated with a given profile name.

methods.name: freeInterChipResources
methods.description: Frees resources and disables the helper.

methods.name: saveDcaGrepResults
methods.description: Retrieves grep results, saves them to a file, and notifies the system.

methods.name: getProfileName
methods.description: Reads the profile name from a file.

methods.name: processEventType
methods.description: Processes different event types received via inotify or inter-processor communication.

methods.name: isHelperEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the helper is enabled.

methods.name: listenForInterProcessorChipEvents
methods.description: Listens for inotify events and processes them accordingly.

methods.name: execNotifier
methods.description: Executes a system command to notify other components of events.

methods.name: interchipDaemonStart
methods.description: Starts the inotify listener for inter-chip events.

methods.name: createNotifyDir
methods.description: Creates the directory for inotify notifications and clears previous stale files.
